correctness.rationale: Independent replay confirms the disproof chain. verify_theta.py reproduces unordered Abrams counts C=(462,1512,1785,920,198,12) with d1d2=d2d3=0; extended check gives d3d4=d4d5=0 on the full complex. 4-edge-per-branch subdivision (V=11,E=12) satisfies Abrams n=5 criterion (branch paths 4>=4, cycles 8>=6), so the cubical model applies; Abrams theorem itself is cited, stated openly. collapse.py reaches (202,467,266,0,0,0); homology_reduced.py verifies the remainder is a SUBCOMPLEX (all faces present), so sequential free-face removals are elementary collapses and homotopy equivalences, leaving a 2-dimensional complex with C3=0. Ranks A1=201, A2=263 over Q and F2,F3,F5 give b=(1,3,3); H2(B5)=ker(A2) subgroup of free group is FREE of rank 3. Upstairs: 120 lifts/cell give C=(24240,56040,31920), C3=0; verify_upstairs.py confirms all lifted faces present (subcomplex) and d1d2=0 over Z on all 31920 columns under the label-ordered sign convention. Hence H2(F5)=ker(d2) is FREE abelian, structurally excluding any Z/2 class independent of ranks. Exact sparse ranks of ordered d2 = 31731 identically over F2,F3,F5,F7,F1000003 (replayed F2,F3,F5,F7,1000003), so b2=189 and dim H2(Fp)=189 for p=2,3,5; ordered d1 rank 24239 via 1-skeleton connectivity (1 component, union-find) plus no-loop certificate gives consistent H1 dim 70. Euler cover check 120=120*1 holds. Freeness + five-modulus rank agreement pins H2(F5)=Z^189, H2(B5)=Z^3. Target Z/2 [w] cannot exist.
